name: search_restaurants
description: Search for restaurants by location, cuisine, or other criteria

location.description: City, neighborhood, or address to search near

cuisine.description: Type of cuisine (e.g., Italian, Japanese, Mexican)

dietary.description: Dietary options required (e.g., vegetarian, vegan, gluten_free, halal, kosher)

max_distance_km.description: Maximum distance from location in kilometers

returns: List of restaurants with name, cuisine, rating, price range, address, hours, and distance

name: get_restaurant_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific restaurant
returns: Full restaurant details including menu highlights, hours, photos, reviews, seating options, and contact info

name: make_reservation
description: Make a table reservation at a restaurant

special_requests.description: Special requests (e.g., highchair, window seat, birthday)

returns: Reservation confirmation with confirmation_id, restaurant name, date, time, and party size

name: cancel_reservation
description: Cancel an existing restaurant reservation
returns: Cancellation confirmation and any applicable cancellation fee

name: modify_reservation
description: Modify an existing restaurant reservation (change date, time, or party size)
returns: Updated reservation details with confirmation

name: get_menu
description: Retrieve the full menu of a restaurant
returns: Menu items organized by category with name, description, price, and dietary labels

name: check_availability
description: Check table availability at a restaurant for a specific date and time
returns: Availability status and alternative time slots if requested time is unavailable

name: get_restaurant_reviews
description: Get customer reviews for a specific restaurant

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return

returns: List of reviews with rating, text, reviewer name, date, and helpfulness votes

name: submit_review
description: Submit a review for a restaurant after dining
returns: Review confirmation with review_id

name: place_food_order
description: Place a delivery or takeout order from a restaurant

items.description: List of menu item objects with item_id and quantity

returns: Order confirmation with order_id, estimated preparation time, delivery ETA, and total cost

name: track_order
description: Track the status of a food delivery or takeout order
returns: Order status (preparing, ready, out_for_delivery, delivered), estimated time, and driver location

name: compare_restaurants
description: Compare multiple restaurants side by side

restaurant_ids.description: List of restaurant IDs to compare

returns: Side-by-side comparison of restaurants across specified criteria

name: get_wait_time
description: Get the current estimated wait time at a restaurant for walk-in guests
returns: Estimated wait time in minutes and current occupancy level

name: join_waitlist
description: Join the virtual waitlist at a restaurant
returns: Waitlist position, estimated wait time, and waitlist_id for tracking

name: get_popular_dishes
description: Get the most popular and highly rated dishes at a restaurant
returns: List of popular dishes with name, description, price, rating, and number of orders

name: search_dishes
description: Search for a specific dish across multiple restaurants

dish_name.description: Name of the dish to search for

returns: List of restaurants offering the dish with price, rating, and restaurant details

name: get_reservation_history
description: Get the user's past and upcoming restaurant reservations

limit.description: Maximum number of reservations to return

returns: List of reservations with details including restaurant, date, time, party size, and status

name: get_dietary_menu
description: Get menu items filtered by specific dietary requirements

include_allergens.description: Include allergen information for each item

returns: Filtered menu items matching dietary requirements with allergen details

name: estimate_meal_cost
description: Estimate the total cost of a meal based on selected items and party size

items.description: List of menu item IDs to include

returns: Itemized cost breakdown with subtotal, tax, tip, and total per person and overall

name: get_happy_hour_deals
description: Find happy hour deals and specials at restaurants and bars
returns: List of happy hour deals with restaurant, times, discounts, and featured items

name: save_restaurant_to_favorites
description: Save a restaurant to the user's favorites list

list_name.description: Name of the favorites list to add to

returns: Confirmation that restaurant was saved to favorites

name: get_favorites_list
description: Retrieve the user's saved favorite restaurants

list_name.description: Name of the specific favorites list

returns: List of favorite restaurants with details and personal notes

name: get_restaurant_hours
description: Get operating hours for a specific restaurant
returns: Operating hours by day, holiday hours, and whether the restaurant is currently open

name: get_nearby_restaurants
description: Get restaurants near a specific location sorted by distance
returns: List of nearby restaurants sorted by distance with basic details

name: apply_promo_code
description: Apply a promotional code to an order or reservation
returns: Updated price with discount applied, or error if code is invalid

name: get_nutrition_info
description: Get nutritional information for a specific menu item

item_id.description: Unique identifier of the menu item

returns: Nutritional breakdown including calories, protein, carbs, fat, sodium, and allergens

name: request_catering_quote
description: Request a catering quote from a restaurant for an event
returns: Catering quote with menu options, price per person, total estimate, and availability

name: split_bill
description: Calculate bill splitting for a group dining experience

custom_splits.description: Custom split amounts per person (for custom split type)

returns: Bill split details with amount per person including tax and tip
